# 0 Set up environment
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# load libraries
library(qqman)
library(circlize)
library(VennDiagram)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)

# Prepare Plotting functions 
manhattan_plot <- function(data, type){
  ggplot(data, aes(x=POS, y=-log10(lrt.pvalue))) +
  geom_point(aes(color=OR_pos), alpha=0.8, size=1.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values= c("skyblue", "orange"))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0) ) +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(), 
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic Position (Start)",
    y = expression(-log[10](italic(p))),
    title = paste0(type, " Manhattan Plot with Significant Hits Annotated")
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05/nrow(data)), color="red", lty="dashed") 
}

QQ_plot <- function(data, type){
  df <- data.frame(expected= (-log10(ppoints(length(data |> pull(lrt.pvalue))))), 
                             observed=(-log10(sort(data |> pull(lrt.pvalue))))) 
  df |>
    ggplot(aes(x = expected, y = observed)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color="red", lty="dashed")  +      
  labs(
    x = "-log10(Expected P)",
    y = "-log10(Observed P)",
    title = paste0(type," QQ plot")
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  xlim(0, 10) +
  ylim(0, 10)
}

```


# 1. SNP-GWAS
## 1.1. Fasttree FEM
```{r}
SNPGWAS_data_FasttreeFEM <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_CDC/15.2.Subanalysis_1/15.2.1.Fasttree_FEM/SNPGWAS_Fasttree_FEM_max5missing.txt", sep = "\t", header=T)|> 
  filter(af>=0.05, af <0.95)|> 
  mutate(POS=as.integer(str_split(as.character(variant), "_", simplify = T)[,2]), 
         OR = exp(beta), 
         OR_pos =ifelse(OR<1, "OR<1", "OR>1"))

# Manhattan Plot
SNPGWAS_data_FasttreeFEM_manplot <- manhattan_plot(SNPGWAS_data_FasttreeFEM, "SNPGWAS") 
SNPGWAS_data_FasttreeFEM_manplot

# QQ plot 
SNPGWAS_data_FasttreeFEM_qqplot <- QQ_plot(SNPGWAS_data_FasttreeFEM, "SNPGWAS") 
SNPGWAS_data_FasttreeFEM_qqplot
```

# 2. DB-GWAS
## 2.1. Fasttree_FEM
```{r}
# Load and prep data
DBGWAS_FastTree_FEM <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_CDC/15.2.Subanalysis_1/15.2.1.Fasttree_FEM/DBGWAS_Fasttree_FEM.txt", sep = "\t", header=T)
DBGWAS_FastTree_FEM_annotations <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_CDC/15.2.Subanalysis_1/15.2.1.Fasttree_FEM/DBGWAS_Fasttree_FEM_annotation.txt", sep = "\t", header=F)
colnames(DBGWAS_FastTree_FEM_annotations) <- colnames(DBGWAS_FastTree_FEM)
DBGWAS_FastTree_FEM_annotations <- DBGWAS_FastTree_FEM_annotations |>
  mutate(coord_range = str_extract(notes, "(?<=:)[0-9]+-[0-9]+"),
         POS = as.integer(str_extract(coord_range, "^[0-9]+")),
         OR = exp(beta), 
         OR_pos =ifelse(OR<1, "OR<1", "OR>1")) 

# Manhattan Plot
DBGWAS_FastTree_FEM_manplot <- manhattan_plot(DBGWAS_FastTree_FEM_annotations, "DBGWAS")
DBGWAS_FastTree_FEM_manplot
# QQ plot 
DBGWAS_FastTree_FEM_qqplot <- QQ_plot(DBGWAS_FastTree_FEM_annotations, "DBGWAS")
DBGWAS_FastTree_FEM_qqplot

# Extract "BP" from the first column by splitting at "_"
positions_DBGWAS_start <- DBGWAS_FastTree_FEM_annotations$start

# Get significance threshold
p_threshold_DBGWAS <- 0.05/nrow(data_DBGWAS)

# Construct final data frame
out_df_DBGWAS <- data.frame(
  CHR = 1,
  SNP = ".",
  BP = as.numeric(positions_DBGWAS_start),
  P= data_DBGWAS_annotations$lrt.pvalue,
  r2 = 0
)

ann_sub <- data_DBGWAS_annotations %>%
  filter(lrt.pvalue < p_threshold_DBGWAS) %>%
  separate(
    notes, 
    into = c("contig_position", "upstream", "gene_in", "downstream"), 
    sep = ";", 
    remove = FALSE, 
    fill = "right"
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_in) %>%
  slice_min(lrt.pvalue, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%  
  ungroup()

# Manhattan Plot
DBGWAS_manplot <- ggplot(data_DBGWAS_annotations, aes(x=start, y=-log10(lrt.pvalue))) +
    # Show all points
  geom_point(aes(color=OR_pos), alpha=0.8, size=1.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values= c("skyblue", "orange"))+
    # custom X axis:
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0) ) +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(), 
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic Position (Start)",
    y = expression(-log[10](italic(p))),
    title = "DBGWAS Manhattan Plot with Significant Hits Annotated"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_threshold_DBGWAS), color="red", lty="dashed") +
    geom_label_repel(data=ann_sub, aes(label=gene_in), size=2,min.segment.length = 0.5) 

# QQ plot 
DBGWAS_qqplot <- qq(out_df_DBGWAS$P)


```
